# Team

A team has 5 seats, including the owner. Each person signs in with their own email and password. The profile and device limits are shared by the team. You pay: members don’t see the team’s invoices.

## Seats · 3 of 5

- Y you@example.comYou Owner
- A anna@example.comIn the team since 3 October [Remove]
- I ivan@example.comInvitation valid until 14 November [Revoke]

When you remove someone from the team, their devices leave the team’s licence.

## Invite

[Invite]

An invitation is valid for 14 days. It can only be accepted by signing in with the invited email.
